title: What exploited vulnerabilities have in common: A data-driven analysis of real-world attacks
contentSnippet:
Real-world exploitation concentrates in a small, high-impact subset of CVEs. Learn how defenders can prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitation likelihood, exposure, and potential blast radius.

title: How we halved DNS build delay and cut memory use by 85%
contentSnippet: Zone setting changes used to rebuild entire DNS zones, even ones with tens of millions of records. Here is how we built a planner that picks the smallest safe build, cutting full builds by 40%, peak memory by 85%, and halving build delay.
